reason: अनुलिप्ता 'smeared over (with darkness)' is a valid synonym of अभिलिप्ता.
शीतवहा 'carrying cool water' is a valid epithet of the Gomatī and fits the sense.
अयोध्याम् उन्मुखः 'facing towards Ayodhyā' is valid Sanskrit with the same meaning.
पुरि is a recognised stem beside पुरी, so पुरिश्रेष्ठे is a valid vocative.
रुचिर 'bright' with ताम्राक्ष is a valid compound that makes sense here.
शीततोया 'having cool water' is a valid epithet of the Gaṅgā.
देवोद्यानयुतां नदीम् is valid and metrically complete (8 syllables); it is another reading, not an error.
आकाशगता 'gone to the sky' is a valid synonym of आकाशगमा.
निर्मलोत्पलसंकुला 'crowded with clear lotuses' is a valid synonym reading.
चक्रवाकोपशोभिता 'adorned by cakravākas' is a valid reading.
देवराजोपवाह्य 'mounts of Indra' is a valid compound in Gita Press's own form of this verse.
संविभक्त 'well divided' is a valid word and fits the description of the roads.
निनादित is a valid synonym of विनादित.
यौवराज्यम् अवेक्षता 'looking after the heir-apparentship' is valid Sanskrit and makes sense.
प्रवाह्यन्ति differs by more than a slip from प्रवक्ष्यन्ति and is a deliberate (ārṣa) reading of pra-vah 'will draw', so keep.
चालिता नौका 'the boat, set moving' is valid and grammatical.
समक्षसे is not a verb form; a dropped ी, the verb is samīkṣase 'you look upon (Brahmaloka)'.
apa-vṛt 'turn aside / lie down' is a valid verb, so अपवर्तामहे is a valid reading.
सुभार्य 'having a good wife' is a valid bahuvrīhi and fits Rāma's lament.
परिदद्याद्धि ... गरं ते मम मातरम् is a coherent Gita Press reading ('may give poison to your and my mother').
यत्तस्याः श्रूयते is grammatical and keeps the half-verse at 16 syllables.
समासीनौ 'seated together' is a valid word in context.
निर्वृत्त 'completed' is a valid word for the day being over.
अभिरत 'delighting in (peacock cries)' is a valid word and gives sense of the mountain.
संघाट 'joining of timbers, raft' is a valid word (MW) and fits exactly.
समाकीर्ण 'strewn over' is a valid synonym of समास्तीर्ण.
वैतस 'of the vetasa reed' is a valid derived adjective.
जम्बु is a recognised stem beside जम्बू.
छित्त्वा is the correct absolutive spelling of chid.
vi+atīta gives vyatīta; व्यातीता is an impossible form with an extra ा.
तन्द्रा is a valid word for drowsiness, as is तन्द्री.
परिदेवना (feminine) is a valid word (MW) beside परिदेवन.
vy-apa-rudh 'exclude from sovereignty' is a recognised Rāmāyaṇa form (MW cites -roruḍhaḥ, R.).
With the object रामं the sense 'having banished Rāma' needs the causative absolutive pravrājya, as Gita Press itself prints 'रामं प्रव्राज्य' at 2.79.2; intransitive pravrajya cannot take रामं.
भवेदस्या 'would be for her' is valid and grammatical.
सा आश्रिता 'she resorted to' is valid in Gita Press's form of the verse.
upa-ā-dhā 'placing (the arm as pillow)' is a valid verb.
उपेतुम् is the common epic form of the infinitive and fits the sense.
नावमन्यते (present) is a valid tense in the question.
A singular पुरोडाशः in the list is valid.
शास्त्रे दृष्टः सनातनैः 'seen in the śāstra by the ancients' is valid in Gita Press's reading.
त्वं मम नैवासि 'you are not mine' is valid and fits Kausalyā's lament.
Bahuvrīhis ending in aṅga may take -ī, so असितापाङ्गी is a valid feminine.
शब्दवेध्यमिदं फलम् is valid and makes sense.
शल्यवेधित 'pierced by the arrow' is a valid synonym of शल्यपीडित.
लोकास्तु अस्त्रयोधिनाम् 'worlds of those who fight with weapons' is valid.
गुरुसेवाभृत् is a valid compound and keeps the pāda at 8 syllables.
With भवन्तौ the verb takes the third person (upaiṣyataḥ), so the second-person थ is a one-letter slip.
ताराधिपसम is a valid synonym of ताराधिपनिभ.
संरक्ता 'reddened' rays of a dying lamp is a valid image.
Causative saṃ-sādh 'overpower, destroy' (Apte, MW) is a valid reading.
Followed by इव, the word must be the plural noun kareṇavaḥ (करेणव इव 'like she-elephants'); करेणेव would double the इव and is a slip of an extra े.
संकालन 'carrying out or burning a corpse' (MW, citing R.) is the exact sense here.
rud is a class-2 verb, so the feminine participle रुदती (pl. रुदत्यः) is correct.
वसुसम्पूर्ण is a valid synonym of वसुसम्पन्न.
प्रहृष्ट 'delighted' is a valid word in context.
संवदन्त(ः) उपतिष्ठन्ते with the epic double sandhi is a valid reading, and upa-sthā makes sense.
The passive विशिष्यन्ते 'are surpassed' is valid.
जलाकुला 'full of water' is a valid epithet of the river.
The messengers are the ones looking at Viṣṇupada, so the active participle prekṣamāṇāḥ is needed; the passive प्रेक्ष्यमाणा ('being looked at') is wrong for the construction.
The metre holds (8 syllables) and विनयिष्यन्तः is a deliberate epic future of vi-nī, not a slip.
निषष्ण्णं is a non-word with a doubled ष्; the participle is niṣaṇṇa.
आपृच्छे is the correct spelling; the others have a typing slip.
संकुल is a valid synonym of संवृत.
अभ्यगात् (aorist of i) is a valid form.
अत्यगात् (aorist of ati-i) is a valid form.
लोहित्य is a recognised form of the place name (MW cf. lohitya) and is the only form Gita Press uses.
यज्विन् is a valid stem (MW), so यज्विभिः is correct.
सरक्ता 'impassioned' is a valid word for the birds' voices.
संलुलित 'disturbed' is a valid word.
राजन् अत्र 'O king, here' is a valid address in Gita Press's reading.
शीलश्रुतितपोनुगा is a valid compound.
pari-vi-vṛt 'roll about' is valid and the half keeps 16 syllables.
संनाम्य (causative absolutive 'having bent') is valid.
इतीमां keeps the pāda at 8 syllables and is valid.
प्रियशंसा 'announcement as if pleasant' is a valid compound.
Putting salt on a wound needs ā-dhā (ādadhāḥ 'you placed'); ā-dā means 'take', so द for ध is a slip.
Gita Press spells this word पुत्रगर्धिनी elsewhere in the Ayodhyā-kāṇḍa (2.37.32, 2.58.24, 2.64.35), so the extra द् here goes against its own spelling.
शौटीर्य 'pride, heroism' is a valid word (MW, citing R.).
बुद्धिमोह is a valid compound.
गुणमुख्या is a valid compound.
तोदित 'goaded' (causative of tud) is valid.
प्राञ्जलिर्भरतस्तदा is a valid 8-syllable pāda.
अत्यर्थं is a valid synonym of अत्यन्तं.
दासैः is a valid word in the list of household members.
पलायमान is the correct participle; the others have a slip.
सहलक्षणः 'with its auspicious marks' is a valid reading.
और्ध्वदेहिक is a valid spelling (MW).
A third-person प्रवारयति about the king is valid.
इन्द्रनीलप्रतिमा 'like sapphire' is valid.
मणिहेम is a valid compound.
कल्यम् 'at dawn' is a valid adverb.
काम्यया is a valid synonym of काङ्क्षया.
संतुष्ट is a valid synonym of संहृष्ट.
यात 'gone' is a valid participle.
